operationInventory.decision: This digest pins every mounted tRPC operation path, kind, defining router, and source file. Any operation-level drift requires an explicit policy review before release.

operationBindings.decision: A router classification is not evidence of agent operability. Only an exact operation named by one reviewed rule counts as a direct tool or bounded alternative; every other operation remains explicitly unbound.

rules.decision: The capability-gated MCP resource exposes the same bounded run/action/approval/outcome chronology for an exact venue and run.
The agent tool and administrator route bind the same durable saveProspectOutreachDraftAction; the agent contract remains review-only and cannot send.
The MCP tool reuses the canonical lifecycle query and exposes a privacy-bounded generation, source-count, review, publication, and delivery-state projection without mutation authority.

The admin route and governed machine tool reuse the same canonical durable request action. Machine execution additionally requires exact venue capability, live worker/run lineage, AI admission, and an evidence-backed approval grant; it can create only an internal draft request and cannot edit, publish, deliver, or expose the result to a client.
Prospect agents receive frozen-scope search, intelligence, and campaign-member reads instead of unrestricted platform-admin CRM projections.
Agents receive tenant-scoped relationship context and client identity without the unrestricted platform directory or management surface.
The account tools expose bounded relationship chronology and canonical-source pointers without granting broad CRM mutation or duplicating raw Gmail bodies.
Agents can retrieve permission-aware current/history knowledge and prepare evidence-linked corrections, but cannot promote or supersede canonical truth.
The agent can prepare an approval item from owner-authored support evidence but cannot invoke Clerk, send an invitation, or create membership.

The agent can prepare a typed exact-venue location proposal and approval item, but cannot create, edit, activate, or publish venue content. Human approval and a separate administrator application create only an inactive draft.
The agent receives a secret-free, tenant-scoped integration projection rather than unrestricted platform readiness data.
A running scoped agent may create an auditable child task under its parent run; it cannot create arbitrary platform tasks or identities.
Agents may create idempotent human-review proposals for enumerated billing actions; the tool performs no Stripe call, cancellation, or access change.
The agent can create only an approval-grant-bound GENERAL_NOTICE draft with fixed safe fields; publication and broad update types remain unavailable.
The resource exposes exact-scope venue identity and availability without platform-wide discovery or mutation.
Agents receive a bounded configuration projection but cannot alter rollout, design, entitlement, or model policy.
The resource exposes approved venue content only; drafts, retired material, broad administrative fields, and writes remain excluded.
Agents can inspect bounded version history while reversion and deletion restoration remain human-controlled.
Agents can inspect package and review state without approval, application, reversion, or deployment authority.
Agents receive exact-venue support summaries and safe attachment eligibility without participant, message, resolution, or package mutation.

The machine tool is deliberately narrower than customer request creation: it creates an exact-venue DRAFT with one INTERNAL_ONLY message, requires verified worker/run/grant lineage, and cannot contact a customer or grant participant access. A human operator must explicitly open or cancel it.
Agents can inspect bounded operational-update state; scheduling, publication, editing, and deactivation remain gated.
Agents receive exact-venue usage plus configured tenant hard-budget state without operator policy material, budget mutation, service suspension, pricing effects, or unrestricted portfolio analytics.
Agents can inspect bounded evaluation evidence; the declared request tool remains unavailable in the safe runtime and is not counted as a binding.
Agents can inspect bounded report state and published output without draft generation, editing, or publication authority.
Agents receive privacy-bounded conversation metadata and review signals, not unrestricted raw replay or visitor interaction authority.
Agents can inspect exact-venue run summaries and lifecycle evidence without cancellation, identity, lease, or unrestricted input/output access.
Agents can inspect scoped operational events; founder briefing aggregation, acknowledgement, resolution, and policy mutation remain separate.
Agents receive bounded deployment history and state without approval, application, rollback execution, or manifest review authority.
Agents can observe exact-tenant rollout state but cannot change tenant flags.

Agents receive explicit secret-free global-admission and provider-exclusion state through exact client/venue health scope, without reasons, operator identity, control mutation, or automatic recovery authority.
Agents receive an exact-venue onboarding summary rather than unrestricted bootstrap inputs, client portal state, or intake mutation.

The policy-backed machine tool is deliberately narrower than human intake creation: it accepts only private NOTES source material, remains AWAITING_REVIEW, preserves exact worker/run/grant lineage, and cannot extract, create or apply a package, publish, or contact a customer.

Agents receive compact onboarding and native-head convergence evidence through the readiness resource; the platform-admin API additionally exposes the exact read-only activation diagnostic. Neither surface switches guest retrieval or authorizes activation, release, publication, or legacy retirement.
Agents can create idempotent scoped questions and inspect exact-venue question state, but cannot answer or promote policy.
Agents can inspect bounded outcome evidence without recording their own reliability verdict as authoritative evidence.
The administrator and agent tool use the same immutable proposal action. Both create review evidence only; neither applies behavior or authority changes.

The administrator and scoped quality worker use one canonical append-only action to bind an approved proposal to immutable implementation and same-corpus before/after evaluation evidence. Recording evidence never promotes behavior or authority.
Agents receive exact-venue versioned proposal evidence and review state without operation IDs or reviewer identities.

categories.decision: The fixed public process-health query is transport liveness, not an authenticated operational agent capability.
The platform-admin aggregate is represented through its domain routers; no generic super-admin agent tool is permitted.
Expose bounded reads, questions, delegation, outcomes, and governed evaluation requests while keeping identity and model rollout privileged.
CRM agents may read and draft but never approve/send; billing agents may read and propose but never mutate Stripe or access.
Agents receive permission-aware account and institutional-memory reads; human admins govern authoritative decisions, priorities, promotion, and supersession.

A separately authenticated platform worker may read exact current founder decisions and the bounded read-only Founder operating view; credential lifecycle and every mutation remain human platform-admin controlled.
Expose safe reads and reviewable drafts; publication, deployment application, and broad mutation remain approval-bound.
Readiness and job state are agent-readable; upload quarantine, malware, and review transitions retain canonical human/system gates.
Agents may inspect support state and create approved drafts; participant, resolution, and attachment boundaries remain canonical.
Client identity and venue state are readable; account lifecycle mutations remain privileged and auditable.
Expose bounded operational intelligence and drafts; provider execution, incident control, and publication stay gated.
Session metadata is privacy-bounded; raw replay and simulation require a separate synthetic developer contract.
Agents may inspect safe state but cannot issue credentials or change entitlements autonomously.
Finalization is high consequence; agents may gain preview/read support but not autonomous finalization.
